title: Mr Wallcover | Wallpaper Installer London
description: London wallpaper installer for prime hotels, flagship retail and private homes. Surveying, management, supply, installation and aftercare.

hero.title: Wallcoverings, hung properly.
hero.lede: Mr Wallcover surveys, manages, supplies and installs wallcoverings for prime hotels, flagship retail and private homes. Aftercare is part of the commission, not an extra.

proof.title: On the wall.
proof.text: Photographs and short films taken on site during the decorating package, 2022–2024.

intro.title: A London practice for rooms that are meant to last.
intro.text: The work is hotel corridors and bedrooms, flagship shops, and private houses. We cover London and the surrounding areas, and work UK-wide for selected projects.

facts.label: Coverage
facts.value: London and the surrounding areas; UK-wide for selected projects

servicesIntro.title: From the survey to the return visit.
servicesIntro.text: One practice carries the job. Survey, management, supply, the hang, and the care of it afterwards.

serviceCards.title: Surveying
serviceCards.text: Measure on site or from drawings. Openings come out. Repeat and wastage go in.

serviceCards.title: Management
serviceCards.text: A project leader on the ground, and a weekly look ahead on a longer job.

serviceCards.title: Supply
serviceCards.text: Free-issue paper received and checked, or procurement when you want it.

serviceCards.title: Installation
serviceCards.text: Silk, grasscloth, fabric, vinyl, hand-painted papers, murals and acoustic panels.

serviceCards.title: Aftercare
serviceCards.text: A return visit once the paper has settled, and twelve months on the workmanship.

featured.title: Hotels, a flagship, and the rooms between.
featured.text: Private houses are not shown. These are commissions already on the public record.

process.title: Five steps, and the same people throughout.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We start with a conversation. We advise, and we listen to the date, the building, and the way you need to keep using it.

steps.title: Scope, room by room
steps.text: After the survey we estimate and write a scope of works by room. Once agreed, that scope is the template for the job. Openings come out of the measure. Pattern repeat and wastage go in.

steps.title: A leader on the ground
steps.text: Every project has a project leader who is your day-to-day contact. They look after the craft, the progress, and what you have been told to expect.

steps.title: Weekly oversight
steps.text: On a longer commission, senior oversight quality-controls the work and agrees with you, each week, what happens next.

steps.title: The same core team
steps.text: The people you meet at the start are the core team that finishes. On a long project, people can stay on site or nearby, where that suits the building and the budget.

aftercare.title: The hang is not finished when we leave.
aftercare.text: About four to six weeks later we come back, once the paper has had a chance to settle. Seams and edges are looked at. For twelve months, workmanship of the hang is guaranteed. Building movement and damp are not.
aftercare.label: Read the aftercare

cta.title: Tell us the building, the material and the date.
cta.text: A hotel floor, a house, a shop, or a paper that needs looking after. Call, send a note, or use WhatsApp.
